## Description

Capture each clinic's pre-Medvya baseline (no-show rate, check-in time, double-booking incidents) during the first 2 weeks, and instrument: check-in time (arrival → checked in) median, no-show rate, double-booking constraint violations, reminder delivery rate. Owner-facing mini report (full reports P4).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Baseline values per clinic are recorded with method and dates.
- [ ] **AC2.** Median check-in time for returning patients is computed from event timestamps and is ≤ 60 s during the measured pilot weeks (exit gate 3) or the gap is reported.
- [ ] **AC3.** Metrics contain no PHI and are visible to owners.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
